prompt:
Use case: style-transfer for a new full-body game character.
Redraw the female ink-scroll mage in IMAGE 1 using the project's CLEAN SIMPLIFIED ICON character style, matching the compact head/body proportions and controlled graphic finish of IMAGES 2 and 3.

REFERENCE ROLES:
Image1 = ONLY the new character's identity, original costume theme, palette and key props.
Images2/3 = drawing/proportion reference ONLY: clear bold contours, intentional large shapes and compact approximately FOUR actual head heights from crown to soles (exclude tall ornaments and props). Never copy their faces, costumes, hairstyle or weapons.
This is a NEW character, not the previous silver-haired butterfly girl. No butterfly cloak, antennas, elemental orbs or yin-yang accessories from other designs.

PRESERVE THIS CHARACTER'S RECOGNIZABLE DESIGN:
A composed elegant adult Chinese-fantasy female ink mage with jade/teal short asymmetrical bob, one broad ivory-white forelock, one eye partly framed/covered by the sweeping fringe, pale green eyes, small calm knowing smile. A black-and-jade brush/feather-shaped hair ornament with restrained dull gold base and one simple small geometric jade/gold clasp. Keep the short bob as 3–4 large hair masses, no long ponytail.
Black/ivory fitted high-collar Chinese robe with broad ivory chest/shoulder facing, jade neck accent, modest original tailored coverage, elegant long asymmetric black side/front skirt panels and visible separate legs, dark ankle boots. Original teal broad split trailing cloth panels sweeping behind to the right. Preserve original adult age and naturally elegant silhouette while redrawing at the project's compact four-head scale; no tall fashion-model legs or tiny head.
Simplify the many gold rings, tiny belt gadgets and embroidery into ONE clear jade/dull-gold waist clasp and a few broad garment edges. Maintain black-white-jade color hierarchy. No new jewelry clutter, repeated small motifs or exposed-body additions.

KEY PROPS AND COMPOSITION:
ONE large flowing Chinese ink PAINTING SCROLL forms an elegant open arc behind and above her head, then curls down behind the body toward lower-right, like image1. It is a continuous broad ivory paper strip with dark ink-black reverse/border and simple cylindrical wooden rollers with dull-gold ends. Preserve the dramatic scroll silhouette but make the construction readable: clear front/back paper turn, consistent width, only a few broad curves; no disconnected strips or tangled paper spaghetti. Inside the visible paper place only TWO or THREE broad gray ink mountain/cloud washes and a few simple bird-like ink strokes. REMOVE all fine pseudo-calligraphy and rows of glyphs. Leave most of the paper quiet.
ONE oversized Chinese calligraphy BRUSH with a simple straight wooden/dull-gold shaft and a thick tapered black brush tuft held across the side at low chest/waist height, its tuft pointing to lower-right, clearly inside the canvas. The shaft is continuous through the gripping hand, no blade replacing the brush tip. Near the neck/shoulder the other hand forms a relaxed small thoughtful gesture like image1. Exactly two arms/hands, coherent wrists and plausible grip, no extra limbs.
Full body in a relaxed asymmetrical STANDING pose, face/chest/pelvis/knees/boots all front three-quarter SCREEN LEFT. One supporting leg and one gently relaxed leg, both boots separated and grounded; no backwards body or crossed legs. The scroll and broad teal cloth sweep to the right to balance her left-facing gaze. Quiet confident scholarly personality.

CRITICAL CLEAN ICON PAINTING:
Use 2–3 LARGE COHERENT light/shadow color shapes per material. Strong controlled dark outside contours, sparse purposeful inner lines, crisp clean cel-painted values with a little organic shape character. Hair = teal base + one broad dark shadow + one limited broad lighter area. White cloth/paper = ivory base + broad cool-gray fold shadow. Black robe = charcoal main plane + deep ink shadow + one broad muted teal/gray light. Gold = dull gold base/shadow, no intricate metallic reflections.
NO grain, noise, scattered triangular facets, tiny polygon mosaic, brush speckles, elaborate folds, tiny hair strands, realistic skin/eyes, glossy 3D crystal rendering or soft airbrush gradients. Large quiet color areas, clear silhouette, details focused at face and one waist ornament. Match the project's simplified icon clarity at thumbnail scale, not a densely rendered illustration.

ONE complete standalone character illustration on a perfectly uniform warm ivory square background. Include all scroll rollers, full upper scroll arc, brush tip, trailing cloth and both feet with approximately 7–8 percent safety margin. No original poster text 'THIRTY-NINE', no date, logo, watermark, text, title, frame, comparison sheet, scenery or scattered ink splashes outside the scroll.
purpose: New teal-haired ink-scroll mage redrawn in the project's compact clean icon style.
visual_review: Teal bob with ivory forelock, black/ivory/jade robe, continuous two-roller scroll, large calligraphy brush and full boots retained. Fine poster lettering/ornament removed and color regions simplified.
